questions.stemEn: A child with Down syndrome and autism is brought by the family because he is a picky eater. How should this be managed?

options.text: Encourage a model family eating plan

questions.explanationAr: المصدر يختار تشجيع model family eating plan. ويشرح أن feeding guidelines تشمل تقليل المشتتات، وضع feeding schedule يساعد على hunger، إبقاء الوجبة في حدود 20–30 دقيقة، تشجيع self-feeding، وتكرار عرض الطعام الجديد بدون ضغط.
questions.reasoningEn: The source favors a positive family mealtime model rather than a strict feeding program or prolonged meals.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Strict food program لا يتماشى مع النهج المرن والهادئ الذي يصفه المصدر. Allowing 60 minutes is longer than the source's recommended 20–30 minute meal duration.
questions.clinicalPearl: The source emphasizes pleasant structured family meals, limited mealtime duration, and repeated food exposure without pressure.
managementSteps: Limit meals to about 20–30 minutes as described by the source
Offer new foods repeatedly without pressure

tts.text: A child with Down syndrome and autism is brought by the family because he is a picky eater. How should this be managed? A. Implement a strict food program. B. Encourage a model family eating plan. C. Allow sixty minutes for feeding time.
